en.title: Black Ops 7 Season 6 Weapons: How to Unlock Them All
en.summary: The final season of Black Ops 7 and Warzone is here, bringing four new weapons to the battlefield. Here's how you can get your hands on them for free.
en.body:
The final season of **Black Ops 7** has officially landed, and with it comes a fresh arsenal for players to master in both multiplayer and **Warzone**. Season 6 introduces four new weapons, including the **TR51 Para** assault rifle, the **VMP** submachine gun, a new melee weapon, and a powerful addition to the special weapon category. These new additions arrive alongside a Halloween-themed Battle Pass, spooky map variants for **Warzone**, and even a **Doom** crossover event. For those eager to get the latest gear without spending a dime, Activision has outlined the free unlock methods.

One of the standout additions is the return of the **VMP** submachine gun, a fan-favorite from **Black Ops 4**. This full-auto SMG is known for its fast handling and rapid fire rate, making it a potent close-to-mid-range option. To unlock the **VMP**, players will need to progress through the Season 6 Battle Pass and claim it as an HVT reward on page three. The weapon features 35 levels to grind, a 40-round magazine, and a variety of attachment slots, including a unique Prestige attachment: the Rear Grip - MFS Tactical Command Grip, designed to boost mobility and recoil control.

## Free Weapon Unlocks for Season 6
The **TR51 Para** assault rifle and the new special weapon are also available through the Battle Pass, with specific challenges detailed within the game. While the exact progression for these weapons isn't fully detailed in the initial announcements, it's standard practice for new primary and secondary weapons to be tied to early tiers of the Battle Pass. The melee weapon will likely require a specific in-game challenge or could be part of a bundle later on. Players who miss the initial unlock window for any of these weapons will be pleased to know they will eventually be added to the Armory section in **Black Ops 7** and **Warzone**. This Armory system allows players to complete alternative unlock challenges to earn any previously missed weapons or gear, ensuring no content is permanently out of reach.

## Don't Miss Your Chance for Free Gear
The introduction of these new weapons marks the culmination of **Black Ops 7**'s seasonal content. While the Armory provides a safety net for missed items, the excitement of unlocking them as they release is a significant draw for the community. Fans often rush to complete Battle Pass tiers and challenges to get the first crack at new loadout options, aiming to gain a competitive edge or simply to complete their collection. The **Doom** crossover, in particular, is expected to generate significant buzz, with operator skins for the **Doom Slayer** and iconic villains adding a unique flair to the season's festivities. Players are advised to check the Battle Pass and the Armory regularly for the most up-to-date unlock requirements.

## What's Next
Season 6 is live now, and players can begin their grind for the new weapons immediately. The Halloween-themed event, **The Haunting**, is also expected to roll out additional content and challenges throughout the season. Keep an eye on the official **Call of Duty** channels for any surprise drops or event updates.

content_raw: The final season of Black Ops 7 arrives on September 17, and Activision has detailed the four new weapons you can earn. Season 6 adds the TR51 Para assault rifle, VMP submachine gun, a melee weapon, and a powerful new gun in the special weapon category. In this guide, we'll detail all of the new Season 6 weapons and how you can unlock them for free. As for new content, Season 6 of Black Ops 7 and Warzone is themed around Call of Duty's annual The Haunting event. There is a brand-new battle pass packed with Halloween-themed operator skins and weapon blueprints. More maps and modes arrive to multiplayer and Zombies this season, while Warzone gets a spooky nighttime variant of the Haven's Hollow Resurgence map. Additionally, the season also includes a crossover event with Doom , featuring operator skins for the iconic Doom Slayer and some of the villains of the franchise. If you miss the unlock window for any weapon on this list, it will be added to the Armory section of the Black Ops 7 and Warzone menus. This will let you complete a different unlock challenge to earn the weapon. This also applies to any of the weapons or loadout items you might've missed from previous seasons of Black Ops 7. VMP VMP submachine gun The VMP submachine gun returns from Black Ops 4, and this a full-auto submachine gun with fast handling with a fast fire rate. How to unlock the VMP: This gun is unlocked for free as an HVT reward on page three of the Season 6 battle pass.  Weapon details: Levels: 35 Mags: 4 Mag Size: 40 Mastery Badges: Yes Attachments: Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods Prestige attachment: Rear Grip - MFS Tactical Command Grip This prestige attachment is designed to improve mobility, recoil control, recoil stabilization, and tac stance spread. TR51 Para TR51 Para assault rifle The TR51 Para assault rifle is a semi-auto assault rifle. The developer describes it as having very high damage and being easy to control at range, but it can be converted to a full-auto rifle with the weapon's prestige attachment. How to unlock the TR51 Para: This gun is unlocked for free as an HVT reward on page six of the Season 6 battle pass. Weapon details: Levels: 41 Mags: 3 Mag Size: 25 Mastery Badges: Yes Attachments: Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods Prestige attachment: Barrel - 18.5" MFS Fallen Angel Barrel This prestige attachment converts the gun from a semi-auto to a slow but fully automatic assault rifle. Arcblade Arcblade melee weapon The Arcblade is a new melee weapon, and it offers high damage, fast attack speed, and moderate range. How to unlock the Arcblade: This is a weapon that can be unlocked for free during Season 6's upcoming Camo Costume Party event. The full details haven't been revealed yet, but you'll be able to earn this weapon and several new camos by completing specific challenges across multiplayer, Zombies, Endgame, and Warzone.
